# netbox_object_type (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox object type (`/api/core/object-types/`) by `id` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_object_type" "example" {
  id = 123
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_object_type" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/core/object-types/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.

### Read-Only

- `app_label` (String) App Label.
- `app_name` (String) App Name.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `features` (Set of String) Features.
- `is_plugin_model` (Boolean) Is Plugin Model.
- `model` (String) Model.
- `model_name` (String) Model Name.
- `model_name_plural` (String) Model Name Plural.
- `public` (Boolean) Public.
- `rest_api_endpoint` (String) Rest Api Endpoint.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name; validated against the parameters of the endpoint.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
